videos.title: How Fast Can a Glacier Move: Crash Course Geology #19
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
What can gouge out lakes, carve through mountains, and make weird marks in the ground that look /exactly/ like yeti claws? Well, not a yeti, probably. In this episode, we’ll learn about glaciers, the huge frozen beasts that have shaped our world – and might soon be leaving it. 

Introduction: Glacie

videos.title: How Do Fossils Form?: Crash Course Geology #18
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Everybody dies, but few fossilize. In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll learn how fossils form and why they’re so rare. Although very few living things ever become fossils, those that /do/ help us understand Earth’s history and how life came to be as it is today. 

Introduction: Nodosaur 0
